data.taskBrief:
TASK BRIEF: Send a notification message to a Slack channel (Slack)

FIT
  Partially. The supplied request can notify technicians by posting a Slack message, but no supplied request geocodes job sites or checks payment status. The Slack request serves the notification portion; geocoding and payment-status requests are not supplied.

AUTH
  OAuth 2.0 authentication is configured, with the access token added to the request header. The schema does not specify the resulting header name or provide credential values. It references authorization URL https://login.xero.com/identity/connect/authorize, token URL https://identity.xero.com/connect/token, authorization-code grant, PKCE S256, and placeholders for client ID, client secret, scopes, and callback URI.

BASE URL
  https://slack.com

STEPS
  1. POST /api/chat.postMessage
     Params (query):
       channel: string — '{{slack user id}}'; Slack channel or user identifier to receive the message.
       text: string — '{{template}}'; message text or notification template.
     Returns:
       No saved response example is provided; the response status and body fields are not specified by the request schema.
     Threading:
       None

GOTCHAS
  - Both parameters are defined in the query string, not in the request body: channel and text.
  - Replace {{slack user id}} and {{template}} with the actual recipient identifier and message content.
  - OAuth placeholders are unresolved in the supplied collection context; obtain and configure the required OAuth 2.0 credential before calling the endpoint.
  - The task's geocoding and payment-status capabilities require other requests or APIs.
